Heads-up: looks like Meet is fine in most cases but some enterprise SSO policies block external organizers or forwarded invites. If the original organizer is a resource or forwarded event (which happens when SDRs schedule), GCal will keep the Meet URL but Everwell blocks the join.

Two practical fixes:
1) Create a one-off Zoom meeting and send an updated invite (simplest; external accepts new event).
2) Reissue the ICS with organizer set to a redwood-managed ops account that Everwell can accept (requires ops to claim/resend from that account).

I recommend option 1 for speed. I can spin up a Zoom link and draft a new invite; Neha — do you want me to send the Zoom invite to Samantha and the Everwell IT address?

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer
